name: Mercure Bangkok Siam Ratchathewi
short_description: A 184-room Mercure with direct access via Exit 4 to Ratchathewi BTS station, one stop from Siam, with an infinity pool and skyline views.
ai_summary: Mercure Bangkok Siam Ratchathewi offers direct access via Exit 4 from Ratchathewi BTS station, connecting straight into the hotel building and one stop from Siam. The 184-room property features The Wandering Elephant restaurant and an infinity pool with skyline views. It shares its address with the adjacent ibis Bangkok Siam Ratchathewi — the two form a twin-tower Accor complex in the Siam-Ratchathewi district. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: 199 Phaya Thai Road, Phetchaburi, Ratchathewi, 10400 Bangkok, Thailand
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 184 rooms with direct BTS station access (Exit 4 connects straight into the building) — genuinely rare convenience
Infinity pool with skyline views and The Wandering Elephant restaurant on-site
One BTS stop from Siam, central Bangkok's main shopping and transit hub
cons: No ALL Rating displayed yet — the property appears newer and doesn't yet show guest sentiment data
Shares its building/address with the budget-tier ibis next door, so it may lack a standalone identity for some travellers
research_highlights: 184 rooms, direct BTS Ratchathewi access via Exit 4
The Wandering Elephant restaurant, infinity pool
